# Shortcuts

These are the defaults of the TrenchBroom preset, which is what a fresh install uses. *File > Preferences > Keymap preset* switches to the Hammer or Blender presets, and *Help > Keyboard Shortcuts...* lists every binding and lets you change any of them.

## Tools

Pressing a tool's key again goes back to Select. Esc cancels a drag or brush stroke in progress and keeps the current tool; otherwise it returns to Select, and in Select it clears the selection.

| Key | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Q | Select, the default for drawing, selecting and moving |
| C | Clip |
| V | Vertex |
| R | Rotate |
| T | Scale |
| Tab | Mesh edit, converting selected brushes |
| Shift+T | Texture |
| P | Paint vertex colours |
| G | Sculpt terrain and displacements |
| Shift+G | Blend materials |
| B | Scatter |
| Shift+E | Volume |
| Shift+P | Path |
| M | Measure |

## Mouse in the views

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Drag on empty space | Draw a brush |
| Drag the selection | Move it. Ctrl leaves a copy, Alt moves vertically in 3D, Shift locks to the main axis |
| Click | Select. Inside a group this selects the object, double click selects the group |
| Ctrl+click | Add to or remove from the selection |
| Shift+click | Select one face |
| Ctrl+Shift+click | Add or remove a face |
| Shift+drag a face (3D) | Push or pull the selected faces |
| Ctrl+Shift+drag a face (3D) | Extrude a new brush outwards |
| Right drag (3D) | Look, with WASD to move and Q/E for down and up |
| Middle drag | Pan |
| Alt+left drag (3D, nothing selected) | Orbit |

> [!NOTE] Ctrl+click and the UV Editor
> While the UV Editor is the tab showing in its panel, Ctrl+click on a brush or mesh selects all of its faces, so every side can be textured at once. Switch that panel to another tab, such as the Inspector, and Ctrl+click toggles objects again.

## Editing

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y | Undo, redo |
| Ctrl+X, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V | Cut, copy, paste at the cursor |
| Ctrl+D | Duplicate |
| Ctrl+Shift+D | Duplicate linked |
| Ctrl+R | Repeat the last rotate, flip, nudge or duplicate. In mesh editing it adds a loop cut instead |
| Delete | Delete |
| Ctrl+A, Esc, Ctrl+I | Select all, none, inverse |
| Ctrl+T, Ctrl+Shift+T | Select touching, select inside |
| Ctrl+G, Ctrl+Shift+G | Group, ungroup |
| Ctrl+H, Ctrl+J, Ctrl+Shift+H | Hide, isolate, show all |
| Arrows, Page Up, Page Down | Nudge by one grid step |

## Brushes, meshes and textures

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Ctrl+K | CSG subtract |
| Ctrl+M | CSG convex merge |
| Ctrl+L | CSG intersect |
| Ctrl+Shift+K | Hollow |
| Ctrl+Shift+B | Shape generator |
| Ctrl+Shift+E | Convert brushes to mesh |
| Ctrl+Shift+J | Join meshes |
| Ctrl+Shift+W | Move brushes to world |
| Ctrl+Shift+U | Toggle UV lock |
| Alt+H | Hotspot fit |

## Mesh edit and the UV Editor

| Input | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Double click a vertex, edge or face (Mesh tool) | Select it and show the transform gizmo on it, in every view |
| Esc (Mesh tool, gizmo shown) | Hide the gizmo, the selection stays |
| Click a UV corner | Select it with the corners stitched to it |
| Shift+click, Ctrl+click a UV corner | Add it, remove it |
| Alt+click a UV corner | Select only that face's corner, to split a stitch |
| Shift+drag, Ctrl+drag on empty UV space | Box select adding, box select removing |
| Drag a UV corner | Move the whole selection, pixel snap applies while dragging |
| Drag empty UV space | Move the texture of every shown face, or box select while Box Select is on |
| Wheel, right drag | Scale, rotate the selected corners, or the whole faces when none are selected |
| Double click a UV corner | Move gizmo, its arrows move along U or V only |
| Esc (pointer over the UV Editor) | Hide the UV gizmo |
| Middle drag, Ctrl+wheel | Pan, zoom the UV canvas |

## View and files

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| F or Ctrl+U | Frame the selection, or the whole map |
| `[` and `]`, or `-` and `=` | Halve or double the grid |
| F2 | Cycle shading |
| F3 | Lit Preview |
| Shift+Space | Maximize the view under the pointer, press again to bring the other views back |
| Ctrl+Shift+1 to 9, Ctrl+1 to 9 | Store and recall camera bookmarks |
| Ctrl+=, Ctrl+-, Ctrl+0 | Interface scale up, down, reset |
| Ctrl+Shift+P or F1 | Command palette |
| Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Shift+S | Save, save as |
| Ctrl+O | Open map |
| Ctrl+N | New map, in a new tab if the current one has unsaved changes |
| Ctrl+Shift+N, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+W | New tab, next tab, close tab |
| F5 | Run the Godot project |

## Other presets

The Hammer preset moves the tools to Shift+S (select), Shift+X (clip), Shift+V (vertex) and Shift+A (texture), and uses H to hide, Ctrl+H to isolate and U to show everything. Because Ctrl+W now moves brushes to world, Ctrl+M opens the shape dialog and Ctrl+L rotates 90°, Close Tab moves to Ctrl+F4, CSG Merge to Ctrl+Shift+M and CSG Intersect to Ctrl+Shift+L. The Blender preset uses A and Alt+A to select all and none, X to delete, Shift+D and Alt+D to duplicate and duplicate linked, S to scale, H and Alt+H to hide and show, Ctrl+J to join meshes, Z to cycle shading, Shift+A for the shape dialog and F3 for the command palette. Because Ctrl+J, Alt+H and F3 are taken this way, Isolate moves to /, Hotspot Fit to Alt+Shift+H and Lit Preview to F4. Every other default binding stays, presets only take over the chords listed here. Anything you rebind yourself sits on top of whichever preset is active, and *Reset overrides* in the shortcuts window clears your changes.
